cyber/button.prompt:
A UI button of the button of the cyber UI style for a street-level heist game of black-market chrome and data runs in a megacity: its border and face, its centre plain so a label reads on it.
Style: Neon vector lines. Thin glowing lines, grids and bright particles on dark fields, like a vector display. Luminous lines on black, grids for space, particle bursts, bloom as the material.
Palette: at most 5 distinct colours in this asset; black plus 2 to 4 saturated hues; each hue one meaning (player, enemy, pickup); white only for the hottest centres.
Nine-slice: the corners (23% left, 32% top, 23% right, 32% bottom of each cell) keep their size, the edges between them stretch along one axis and the centre both ways: put every ornament in the corners, keep the edges even along their length and the centre plain.
Background: fully transparent, nothing outside the subject.
Line: the line is the shape.
Reference: the image shows the style; match its palette, line and rendering, not its content.
Avoid: filled shaded surfaces; grey backgrounds; too many hues; a background or ground shadow; text, letters or watermarks.
Shape: one single button only, centred, filling the image across its width, 2.18 times as wide as it is tall (96 x 44 proportions); nothing else in the image.
Art direction: A secondary button in its states: a near-black (#0d0e10) rectangle with its top-left and bottom-right corners cut off at 45° and a 1.5 px acid-yellow (#f5e60c) edge line following the cuts; the label area flat near-black so light text reads on it. Hovered: the edge brighter and the ground one step lighter. No dots, rivets or marks inside its corners. As the Back and Reset to Default keys of the concept. Everything outside its cut corners is fully transparent. The cut corners are hard straight 45° diagonals, about one sixth of the piece's height (about 16 px at this size): crisp, never rounded or bevelled softly; every other corner is a perfectly square 90° corner with radius 0. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge. The cut ends are plain too, so it reads cleanly when short.
The reference images are the approved concept of this style's screens: paint this piece as it appears there, in their exact material, colour, ornament and finish; do not copy their layout or text.
